title: Simulated Ages
summary: Simulate data from a normal model with rnorm() and check the simulation against pnorm().
hints: `rnorm(1000, mean = 40, sd = 5)` draws 1,000 values from the model.
`mean(ages > 50)` is the proportion of simulated ages above 50.
The exact proportion is the area above 50: `pnorm(50, mean = 40, sd = 5, lower.tail = FALSE)`.
